figures.caption: Figure 2: An overview of JourneyFormer. The guest sequence consists of a long-term sequence (events from the past 7 years, excluding frequent events like listing views) and a short-term sequence (frequent events from the past 21 days). The guest sequence, the search query and the retrieved listing candidates use a shared feature pool to construct feature representations. They are then processed by a sequence encoder and a ranking model to generate listing scores.
Figure 5: An illustration of model serving.
